inlines.v: DISORGANIZATION, noun [See Disorganize.] 1. The act of disorganizing; the act of destroying organic structure, or connected system; the act of destroying order. 2. The state of being disorganized. We speak of the disorganization of the body, or of government, or of society, or of an army.
